semantics.definition: The Mannequin, a character of the old No Origins project, made with Meshy.ai: its model and its look, as small copies, and the element of the 3D world they make, drawn by the world’s three.js as tall as a character is. It stands plainly, legs straight and arms down, or walks or runs on its place.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one the mannequin every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Be a person in the 3D world.

state.standing: standing plainly on its place, legs straight, arms down at its sides
state.walking: walking on the spot, with the walk its model carries
state.running: running on the spot, with the run its model carries
